List and Clear the Local Cache

Source: R/cache.R
cacheList.Rd

Downloads are kept in a local cache so that repeated calls are fast and work offline. cacheList() shows what is stored, e.g. to see which stands are available without network access; cacheClear() removes entries, e.g. to free disk space or to force a complete new download.

Usage

cacheList(source = NULL)

cacheClear(source = NULL)

Arguments

source

optional source name to restrict the operation to, one of "agvch", "pxweb", "sdmx", "area", "geometry", "themakart", "priminfo"; NULL for all sources.

Value

cacheList() returns a data.frame with the columns source, version, file, sizeMb and modified. cacheClear() returns the number of removed files invisibly.

Details

The cache lives in tools::R_user_dir()("helvetia", "cache"); set options(helvetia.cacheDir = <path>) to use another directory. A single result is refreshed with the argument refresh = TRUE of the respective data function.

See also

Other swiss.source: sourceInfo()

Examples

cacheList()
#> [1] source   version  file     sizeMb   modified
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
